note: Everything a player can carry. Shaped like the shared item lists of the GTA roleplay frameworks (name, label, weight in grams, kind, unique, useable, description), with the game's own fields: price in naira, heal (health given back when used), weapon (what it puts in the hand), ammoFor (the weapon it loads). Names and brands are made up.
